A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we present a new approach for a RANSAC-based preprocessing technique which transforms the irregular point clouds into a set of surface patches.
the approach is able to reduce a point cloud of more than 100 million points to a few thousand patches and to group these patches into a few hundred large planes.
the proposed approach is able to reduce the amount data and at the same time it is able to identify the relevant parts of a scene.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a simple RANSAC based approach is able to group a huge amount of points into a few geometric primitives in a reasonable time.
the RANSAC based clustering of the points is a good preprocessing step for building reconstructions.
we can use a simple RANSAC approach to extract large planes from huge point clouds.
